summary: Master Whistleblowing System Design and Case Management to build ISO 37002-aligned programs, conduct impartial investigations, and prevent retaliation.
lede: Whistleblowing system design helps compliance, audit, legal, HR and risk professionals build sound reporting and investigation processes. The training covers secure intake channels, structured allegation assessments, impartial investigations, evidence documentation and retaliation-risk monitoring. Learners also practice managing cases from intake to closure and communicating findings through clear reports and program measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who oversee reporting mechanisms, conduct investigations, and ensure compliance with global whistleblower standards. It is ideal for intermediate practitioners with experience in audit, compliance, HR, legal, or risk functions who need to build credible, retaliation-free systems.
modules: Core Investigation Framework and Evidence Collection
Advanced Case Management and Trend Aggregation
Program Integration, KPIs, and Strategic Roadmapping
Technology Integration and AI in Case Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of business processes and basic financial principles. Experience in internal audit, accounting, risk management, or general management is recommended. No prior forensic accounting experience is required, but familiarity with the COSO Framework is beneficial. A laptop is required for hands-on exercises involving digital evidence management and workflow design.
